gloss: always having on hand; keeping in stock; standing (army, equipment)

definitions.gloss: always having on hand; keeping in stock; standing (army, equipment)
definitions.explanation: Used for items or resources kept available at all times for regular or emergency use.

examples.japanese: {常備|じょうび}{薬|やく}を{持|も}っていますか。
examples.english: Do you have any medicines you keep on hand?

examples.japanese: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}に{常備|じょうび}している{食材|しょくざい}がある。
examples.english: There are ingredients I always keep stocked in the fridge.

examples.japanese: {非常|ひじょう}{用|よう}の{懐中電灯|かいちゅうでんとう}を{家|いえ}に{常備|じょうび}しておくべきだ。
examples.english: You should always keep an emergency flashlight at home.

notes:
Means keeping something always available and ready to use. The word combines {常|じょう} (always) and {備|び} (preparation). In everyday use, it most commonly appears in the compound {常備薬|じょうびやく} (medicines kept on hand) and in cooking contexts where people talk about {常備菜|じょうびさい} (prepared dishes kept ready in the fridge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常備薬|じょうびやく}: medicines kept on hand
- {常備菜|じょうびさい}: meal-prepped side dishes
- {常備|じょうび}する: to keep on hand, stock regularly
- {常備品|じょうびひん}: items kept in stock
- {常備軍|じょうびぐん}: standing army

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {備蓄|びちく}: stockpiling — emphasizes accumulating reserves, especially for emergencies
- {用意|ようい}: preparation — broader term for getting something ready
